# Document Templates

This directory contains document templates and language guides for policies and patient-facing materials.

## Available Resources

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Template Language Guide](template-language-guide.md) | Concise language examples for consent forms, HIPAA notices, financial policies, telehealth consent, records release, controlled substance agreements, and after-hours policies |

## Planned Templates

- Patient consent for treatment
- HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices
- Authorization for release of information
- Financial policy agreement
- After-hours policy
- Controlled substance agreement
- Telehealth consent

> [!NOTE]
> We intentionally do not provide a membership agreement template due to the legal complexity and state-specific requirements. Consult a healthcare attorney in your state for membership agreements.

## Important Disclaimer

These templates are provided as starting points only. Direct Primary Care regulations vary by state, and legal requirements change over time.

**Always have an attorney licensed in your state review and customize these documents before use.**

## Usage Notes

- Templates are provided in PDF format
- Editable versions (Word/Google Docs) may be available for some templates
- State-specific variations are noted where applicable
- Review all templates annually for compliance updates

## Contributing

When adding document templates:

1. Use `template-` prefix in filename
2. Note any state-specific requirements
3. Include version date in document footer
4. Provide both PDF and editable format when possible
